files.content:
# About this site

This is Buster Franken's portfolio, built as a retro web operating system. Every window is one of my projects — some run live inside their window, some open in a new tab, and some show screenshots.

## Built on ryOS

The desktop, window manager, and themes are forked from **ryOS** by Ryo Lu (github.com/ryokun6/ryos), an open-source web OS. I stripped out the backend — AI assistant, chat rooms, cloud sync — to make this a fully client-side static site, then filled the apps with my own work.

- **Stack:** React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind · Zustand · Vite
- **Storage:** everything lives in your browser (IndexedDB) — nothing is sent anywhere
- **License:** AGPL-3.0, inherited from ryOS — the source stays public

## Switch the OS

Open **Control Panels → Appearance** to flip the whole desktop between **Mac OS X** and **Windows**.

Source: github.com/BusterFranken/ryos-portfolio · Original: github.com/ryokun6/ryos

files.content:
# Getting around

## The basics
- Launch things from the **Desktop icons**, the **Finder**, or the  / Start menu
- Drag windows to move, drag edges to resize, minimize to the dock/taskbar
- Switch the whole OS look in **Control Panels → Appearance** (Mac OS X ⟷ Windows)
- Lost the layout? The  menu has a **Reset Desktop**

## The projects
- **Live project windows** load a real, deployed site right inside the window
- **Gallery** collects screenshots from things that don't live on the web (Workout, jDog, talks)
- **Videos** has a few of my talks
- **Résumé** opens my CV; **Substack** collects my writing
- Any window with a **↗** button opens the real thing in a new tab

## Handy apps
- **Terminal** — try `whoami`, `projects`, and `contact`
- **Contacts** — my email and links
- **TextEdit** — start with *README*
- **Internet Explorer** — a plain browser for the live sites
- **Minesweeper**, **iPod**, **Paint**, **Photo Booth**, **Synth** — because why not

## Easter eggs
There are a few hidden things. One window will even try to escape the OS entirely. Have a dig.
